blocks.text: Hech kim, hech narsa: nobody, nothing

O'zbek tilida «hech kim», «hech narsa» doim **inkor fe'l** bilan keladi: «**Hech kim** kel**ma**di», «**Hech narsa** ko'r**ma**dim». Bu gaplarda ikki inkor bor. Ingliz tilida bitta gapda inkor **faqat bitta** bo'ladi (77-dars). Shuning uchun inglizchada ikki yo'l bor: yo fe'l inkorda + **anybody / anything** (I **didn't** see **anybody**), yo fe'l tasdiqda + **nobody / nothing** (I saw **nobody**). Ikkalasi birga — «I didn't see nobody» — xato.

O'zbeklarning eng ko'p xatosi — ikki inkorni ko'chirish: «I didn't see nobody.» → **I didn't see anybody.** / **I saw nobody.**; «Nobody didn't come.» → **Nobody came.**; «I don't know nothing.» → **I don't know anything.** / **I know nothing.**; «Anybody doesn't know.» → **Nobody knows.** Qoida: o'zbekchadagi «hech» ham, fe'ldagi `-ma-` ham inkor — inglizchada ulardan **bittasi** qoladi.

Kishi haqida `-body` va `-one` shakllari bir xil ma'noda: **anybody** = **anyone**, **nobody** = **no-one** (no one deb ajratib ham yoziladi). Narsa haqida faqat `-thing`: **anything**, **nothing**. Bu so'zlar birlikda hisoblanadi: **Nobody knows** (know emas), **Nothing is** ready.

Ega o'rnida, gap boshida faqat **nobody / no-one / nothing** keladi va fe'l **tasdiq**da, birlikda turadi. O'zbekcha «Hech kim bilmaydi» dagi inkor `-ma-` inglizchaga ko'chmaydi: **Nobody knows**. «Anybody doesn't know» yoki «Anything didn't happen» degan gap ingliz tilida yo'q.

items.translation: Bu yil tug'ilgan kunimni **hech kim eslamadi**.

items.text: **Nothing** was ready when the guests arrived.
items.translation: Mehmonlar kelganda **hech narsa tayyor emas** edi.

blocks.text: Fe'ldan keyin: not ... anything yoki nothing

Fe'ldan keyin (to'ldiruvchi) ikkala yo'l ham to'g'ri: I **didn't** say **anything** = I said **nothing**. So'zlashuvda **not ... any-** ko'proq ishlatiladi; **nobody / nothing** qat'iyroq, kuchliroq eshitiladi. **never** ham inkor so'z, shuning uchun undan keyin ham **any-**: He **never** tells **anybody**.

items.text: We didn't meet **anybody** on the mountain path.
On the way back we met **nobody**.

items.translation: Bobom **hech qachon hech narsani** tashlab yubormaydi.

blocks.text: Savolda — **anybody / anyone / anything**: Did **anybody** call? Is there **anything** to drink? O'zbekchada bu yerda «biror kishi», «kimdir», «biror narsa» deyiladi. Who ...? va What ...? savollariga qisqa javob — **Nobody.** / **No-one.** va **Nothing.** («Hech kim.», «Hech narsa.»).

items.text: Is **anyone** sitting here? — No, it's free.
items.translation: Bu yerda **biror kishi** o'tiribdimi? — Yo'q, bo'sh.

items.text: What's in that bag? — **Nothing**, it's empty.
items.translation: Anavi sumkada nima bor? — **Hech narsa**, bo'sh.

blocks.text: Eslab qolish: o'zbekcha gapni inglizchaga o'girayotganda «hech»ni ko'rsangiz, o'zingizdan so'rang: fe'lni inkor qilaymi (**didn't** + anything) yoki «hech»ni **no-** bilan aytaymi (**nothing**)? Ikkalasini birga emas. Gap boshida esa doim **Nobody / Nothing**.
**somebody / something** (kimdir, nimadir) va **anywhere / nowhere** → 79-dars. **some / any** → 76-dars, **no / none** → 77-dars, **everybody / everything** → 80-dars.

examples.title: not ... **anybody** / **anyone**
examples.description: Kishi haqida inkor: fe'l inkorda + **anybody** / **anyone** (ikkalasi bir xil). «Hech kimni ko'rmadim» — I didn't see **anybody**. «didn't see nobody» — xato.

sentences.text: I didn't see **anybody** in the office this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab ofisda **hech kimni ko'rmadim**.

sentences.text: Bekzod is new in Tashkent and doesn't know **anyone** yet.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Toshkentga yangi kelgan, hali **hech kimni tanimaydi**.

sentences.text: Please don't tell **anybody** about my plans.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, rejalarim haqida **hech kimga aytmang**.

sentences.text: We knocked on the door, but there wasn't **anyone** at home.
sentences.translation: Eshikni taqillatdik, lekin uyda **hech kim yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: Madina was so shy that she didn't speak to **anybody** at the party.
sentences.translation: Madina shunchalik uyatchan ediki, ziyofatda **hech kim bilan gaplashmadi**.

sentences.text: I called the bank three times, but I couldn't talk to **anyone**.
sentences.translation: Bankka uch marta qo'ng'iroq qildim, lekin **hech kim bilan gaplasha olmadim**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours are away, so there isn't **anybody** to feed their cat.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz ketgan, shuning uchun mushugiga ovqat beradigan **hech kim yo'q**.

sentences.text: Sarah doesn't want to see **anyone** today — she's feeling ill.
sentences.translation: Sara bugun **hech kimni ko'rishni xohlamaydi** — o'zini yomon his qilyapti.

sentences.text: James hasn't invited **anybody** to his birthday yet.
sentences.translation: Jeyms tug'ilgan kuniga hali **hech kimni taklif qilmagan**.

sentences.text: When I arrived at the station, there wasn't **anyone** to meet me.
sentences.translation: Vokzalga yetib kelganimda, meni kutib oladigan **hech kim yo'q** edi.

examples.title: not ... **anything**
examples.description: Narsa haqida inkor: fe'l inkorda + **anything**. «Hech narsa yemadi» — He didn't eat **anything**. **never** ham inkor, undan keyin ham **anything**.

sentences.text: I'm not hungry — I don't want **anything**, thanks.
sentences.translation: Qornim och emas — **hech narsa istamayman**, rahmat.

sentences.text: Aziz didn't eat **anything** before the exam.
sentences.translation: Aziz imtihon oldidan **hech narsa yemadi**.

sentences.text: It was dark, and we couldn't see **anything**.
sentences.translation: Qorong'i edi, **hech narsani ko'ra olmadik**.

sentences.text: Don't buy **anything** for my birthday, please.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, tug'ilgan kunimga **hech narsa olmang**.

sentences.text: Emma listened to the lecture, but she didn't understand **anything**.
sentences.translation: Emma ma'ruzani tingladi, lekin **hech narsa tushunmadi**.

sentences.text: There isn't **anything** in the fridge — let's order a pizza.
sentences.translation: Muzlatgichda **hech narsa yo'q** — pitsa buyurtma qilaylik.

sentences.text: My little brother never says **anything** at dinner.
sentences.translation: Ukam kechki ovqatda **hech qachon hech narsa demaydi**.

sentences.text: The police searched the car, but they didn't find **anything**.
sentences.translation: Politsiya mashinani tintuv qildi, lekin **hech narsa topmadi**.

sentences.text: Tom hasn't done **anything** for the project — it isn't fair.
sentences.translation: Tom loyiha uchun **hech narsa qilmagan** — bu adolatdan emas.

sentences.text: Dilnoza was so tired that she didn't remember **anything** about the film.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza shu qadar charchagan ediki, film haqida **hech narsani eslay olmadi**.

examples.title: **Nobody** / **No-one** + positive verb
examples.description: Ega bo'lganda faqat **nobody** / **no-one**, fe'l esa **tasdiqda** va birlikda: **Nobody knows**. O'zbekcha «Hech kim bilmaydi» dagi inkor fe'l inglizchaga ko'chmaydi.

sentences.text: **Nobody** knows the answer.
sentences.translation: Javobni **hech kim bilmaydi**.

sentences.text: **No-one** came to the meeting because of the rain.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir tufayli yig'ilishga **hech kim kelmadi**.

sentences.text: The phone rang, but **nobody** answered it.
sentences.translation: Telefon jiringladi, lekin **hech kim ko'tarmadi**.

sentences.text: **Nobody** in my family speaks German.
sentences.translation: Oilamda **hech kim** nemischa **gapirmaydi**.

sentences.text: Is this seat free? — Yes, **no-one** is sitting there.
sentences.translation: Bu joy bo'shmi? — Ha, u yerda **hech kim o'tirmayapti**.

sentences.text: **No-one** has lived in that old house for years.
sentences.translation: Anavi eski uyda yillardan beri **hech kim yashamaydi**.

sentences.text: It was a secret, so **nobody** told the children.
sentences.translation: Bu sir edi, shuning uchun bolalarga **hech kim aytmadi**.

sentences.text: Aziz shouted for help, but **no-one** heard him.
sentences.translation: Aziz yordam so'rab qichqirdi, lekin uni **hech kim eshitmadi**.

sentences.text: **Nobody** likes working at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari ishlashni **hech kim yoqtirmaydi**.

sentences.text: When Sarah moved to Bukhara, **nobody** there spoke English, so she learned Uzbek.
sentences.translation: Sara Buxoroga ko'chib kelganida, u yerda **hech kim** inglizcha **bilmas edi**, shuning uchun u o'zbekchani o'rgandi.

examples.title: **Nothing** happened. I've got **nothing** to do.
examples.description: **nothing** — «hech narsa». Ega bo'lganda fe'l tasdiqda: **Nothing** happened. To'ldiruvchi bo'lganda ham fe'l tasdiqda: He said **nothing** = He didn't say **anything**.

sentences.text: **Nothing** happened while you were away.
sentences.translation: Siz yo'qligingizda **hech narsa bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: I've got **nothing** to do this evening.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **hech qanday ishim yo'q**.

sentences.text: There's **nothing** on TV tonight — let's go out.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun televizorda **hech narsa yo'q** — tashqariga chiqaylik.

sentences.text: Bekzod said **nothing** about his new job.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi ishi haqida **hech narsa demadi**.

sentences.text: **Nothing** in this shop is cheap.
sentences.translation: Bu do'konda **hech narsa arzon emas**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, there's **nothing** wrong with your car.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, mashinangizda **hech qanday nosozlik yo'q**.

sentences.text: Madina knew **nothing** about computers when she started the course.
sentences.translation: Madina kursni boshlaganida kompyuter haqida **hech narsa bilmas edi**.

sentences.text: We waited for an hour, but **nothing** changed.
sentences.translation: Bir soat kutdik, lekin **hech narsa o'zgarmadi**.

sentences.text: Thank you for the present! — Oh, it's **nothing**.
sentences.translation: Sovg'a uchun rahmat! — E, **arzimaydi**.

sentences.text: The thief took **nothing** from the house, but he broke the window.
sentences.translation: O'g'ri uydan **hech narsa olmadi**, lekin derazani sindirib ketdi.

examples.title: Questions: Did **anybody** ...? Is there **anything** ...?
examples.description: Savolda **anybody / anyone / anything**: Did **anybody** phone? Is there **anything** to eat? O'zbekchada — «biror kishi», «kimdir», «biror narsa».

sentences.text: Did **anybody** phone while I was out?
sentences.translation: Men yo'qligimda **biror kishi** qo'ng'iroq qildimi?

sentences.text: Is there **anything** to eat? I'm starving.
sentences.translation: Yeyishga **biror narsa** bormi? Qornim juda och.

sentences.text: Does **anyone** here speak Russian?
sentences.translation: Bu yerda ruscha biladigan **biror kishi** bormi?

sentences.text: Have you heard **anything** from Sarah since she moved to Oxford?
sentences.translation: Sara Oksfordga ko'chib ketganidan beri undan **biror** xabar eshitdingizmi?

sentences.text: Can I get you **anything** from the shop?
sentences.translation: Do'kondan sizga **biror narsa** olib kelaymi?

sentences.text: Was there **anyone** at reception when you arrived?
sentences.translation: Siz kelganingizda qabulxonada **biror kishi** bormidi?

sentences.text: Do you know **anybody** in Manchester? I'm moving there next month.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda **biror tanishingiz** bormi? Kelasi oy o'sha yerga ko'chib o'tyapman.

sentences.text: Excuse me, did you notice **anything** strange last night?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, kecha kechasi **biror g'alati narsani** sezdingizmi?

sentences.text: Has **anyone** seen my keys? I can't find them.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni **kimdir** ko'rdimi? Topa olmayapman.

sentences.text: Would you like **anything** else? — No, thank you, that's all.
sentences.translation: Yana **biror narsa** xohlaysizmi? — Yo'q, rahmat, shu yetarli.

examples.title: Short answers: **Nobody**. **Nothing**.
examples.description: Who ...? savoliga qisqa javob — **Nobody.** / **No-one.**; What ...? savoliga — **Nothing.** O'zbekchada ham shunday: «Hech kim.», «Hech narsa.»

sentences.text: Who did you meet in town? — **Nobody**. It was very quiet.
sentences.translation: Shaharda kim bilan uchrashdingiz? — **Hech kim** bilan. Juda jimjit edi.

sentences.text: What did you buy at the market? — **Nothing**. The prices were crazy.
sentences.translation: Bozordan nima oldingiz? — **Hech narsa**. Narxlar osmonda edi.

sentences.text: You look upset. What's wrong? — Oh, **nothing**. I'm just tired.
sentences.translation: Xafa ko'rinyapsiz. Nima bo'ldi? — E, **hech narsa**. Shunchaki charchadim.

sentences.text: Who's in the kitchen? — **No-one**. Why?
sentences.translation: Oshxonada kim bor? — **Hech kim**. Nega?

sentences.text: So, any plans for the weekend? — **Nothing** special.
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, dam olish kunlariga rejalar bormi? — **Alohida hech narsa** yo'q.

sentences.text: Madina, who helped you with this essay? — **Nobody** — I wrote it myself!
sentences.translation: Madina, bu inshoni yozishda sizga kim yordam berdi? — **Hech kim** — o'zim yozdim!

sentences.text: And what did the doctor say? — **Nothing** new — just rest and drink water.
sentences.translation: Shifokor nima dedi? — **Yangi hech narsa** — faqat dam oling va suv iching.

sentences.text: Dad, who's calling at this hour? — **No-one** important, it's a wrong number.
sentences.translation: Dada, bu mahalda kim qo'ng'iroq qilyapti? — **Hech kim**, xato raqam ekan.

sentences.text: What did Bekzod bring to the party? — **Nothing**, as usual!
sentences.translation: Bekzod ziyofatga nima olib keldi? — Odatdagidek, **hech narsa**!

sentences.text: Who was at the door? — **Nobody**. It was the wind.
sentences.translation: Eshik oldida kim bor edi? — **Hech kim**. Shamol ekan.

examples.title: A police interview: Did you see **anybody**?
examples.description: Politsiya xodimi va guvoh suhbati: savolda **anybody / anything**, javobda **not ... anybody** yoki **nobody / nothing** — har doim bitta inkor.

sentences.text: — Good evening. Did you see **anybody** near the shop last night?
sentences.translation: — Xayrli kech. Kecha kechasi do'kon yonida **biror kishini** ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: — Sorry, I didn't see **anybody**. The street was empty.
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, **hech kimni ko'rmadim**. Ko'cha bo'm-bo'sh edi.

sentences.text: — Did you hear **anything** strange — a noise, a car?
sentences.translation: — **Biror g'alati narsa** eshitdingizmi — shovqin, mashina ovozi?

sentences.text: — No, I heard **nothing**. I was asleep by eleven.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **hech narsa eshitmadim**. Soat o'n birda uxlab qolgandim.

sentences.text: — Does **anyone** else live in your flat?
sentences.translation: — Kvartirangizda yana **kimdir** yashaydimi?

sentences.text: — **Nobody**. I live alone.
sentences.translation: — **Hech kim**. Yolg'iz yashayman.

sentences.text: — Has **anybody** asked you about this before?
sentences.translation: — Bu haqda sizdan ilgari **biror kishi** so'radimi?

sentences.text: — No, you're the first. **Nobody** told me about the robbery.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, birinchisi sizsiz. O'g'irlik haqida menga **hech kim aytmagan**.

sentences.text: — I see. Is there **anything** else you remember?
sentences.translation: — Tushunarli. Yana **biror narsa** esingizda bormi?

sentences.text: — Sorry, **nothing** else. I hope you find the thief.
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, **boshqa hech narsa** yo'q. O'g'rini topasiz degan umiddaman.

examples.title: Mixed practice: **nobody**, **anything**, **nothing**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ega o'rnida **Nobody / Nothing**, inkor fe'ldan keyin **anybody / anything**, savolda **anyone / anything** — har doim bitta inkor.

sentences.text: **Nobody** told me the lesson was cancelled, so I came for nothing.
sentences.translation: Dars bekor qilinganini menga **hech kim aytmadi**, shuning uchun bekorga keldim.

sentences.text: Is there **anything** I can do for you before I leave?
sentences.translation: Ketishimdan oldin siz uchun **biror narsa** qila olamanmi?

sentences.text: The museum was closed, and there wasn't **anybody** to ask.
sentences.translation: Muzey yopiq edi, so'rashga **hech kim yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: Aziz is very quiet — he never tells **anybody** about his problems.
sentences.translation: Aziz juda kamgap — u o'z muammolari haqida **hech qachon hech kimga gapirmaydi**.

sentences.text: We've got **nothing** for dinner — shall I go to the shop?
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatga **hech narsa yo'q** — do'konga borib kelaymi?

sentences.text: Did **anyone** remember to bring a camera?
sentences.translation: **Birortangiz** fotoapparat olishni esladingizmi?

sentences.text: Emma looked in the box, but there was **nothing** inside.
sentences.translation: Emma qutiga qaradi, lekin ichida **hech narsa yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: Teenagers say there's **nothing** to do in this village.
sentences.translation: O'smirlar bu qishloqda qiladigan **hech narsa yo'q** deyishadi.

sentences.text: **No-one** in our class failed the exam — the teacher was very happy.
sentences.translation: Sinfimizda **hech kim** imtihondan **yiqilmadi** — o'qituvchi juda xursand bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Don't open the door to **anybody** while I'm out.
sentences.translation: Men yo'qligimda eshikni **hech kimga ochma**.
